Confirmed by isolated node repro. today (new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]) had the same UTC-vs-local-date bug on a narrower scale (wrong during the first ~3 hours of each local day).
bugs.fix: Rewrote addDays to pure UTC arithmetic: new Date(Date.UTC(y, m-1, d+n)).toISOString().split("T")[0] — never touches local time, so the offset can't leak in. Rewrote today to build from now.getFullYear()/getMonth()/getDate() (local calendar date) instead of toISOString().

bugs.error_message: الورد الفعلي/الورد المقرر غلط لما الخطة ماشية بالعكس (من ورا لقدام) — a reverse-direction plan always recorded the day as complete and showed the wrong leftover ayah count
bugs.root_cause: A day's slice is always stored low->high, but a reverse plan works it from its HIGH end downward, so the day's finish point is the slice's START, not its END. The attendance UI hardcoded the forward assumption in 4 places: the completion picker defaulted to {surahEnd, ayahEnd} (= 'nothing done' in reverse, yet treated as full), 'الورد كامل' set the same wrong point, isFull was actualFlat >= assignmentEndFlat, and shortfall was assignmentEndFlat - actualFlat (measured from the wrong end). Net effect: every reverse-plan day saved as status 'done', so no shortfall was ever redistributed. The server's reflowStudentPlan was already direction-aware (isForwardDoc), so only the client's framing was wrong — plus recordOccurrence's 'done' branch stamping completedThrough = entry.surahEnd for reverse docs. Direction was also taken from the shared plan only, ignoring that a student's own overlay can run the opposite way (custom-range individual plan).
bugs.fix: Added isReversedSchedule (mirrors server isForwardDoc, infers direction from a student's own occurrences), dayFinishPoint and dayShortfallAyahs to quran-hifz/src/quran/lib/quranRange.ts, and used them for the default completion point, the 'الورد كامل' button, isFull/shortfall display and the done-vs-partial decision in both TeacherAttendance.tsx and TeacherTrackDetail.tsx; per-student direction now overrides the base plan's. Server: exported isForwardDoc and made recordOccurrence's 'done' branch stamp completedThrough = entry.surahStart/ayahStart for a reverse doc. IndividualPlanPanel now reads direction from the student's own schedule too.

bugs.error_message: Teacher reported (Arabic): in الورد الفعلي, picking a surah from the dropdown to mark where a student stopped does nothing — selection does not register — and it happens on students whose plan direction is بالعكس (reversed). Same symptom in the attendance/غياب recording UI.
bugs.root_cause: CompactSurahAyah (the actual-completion surah+ayah picker) always listed all 114 surahs, but onChange ran the picked point through clampToAssignment(v, assignment), which silently snaps any point outside the days own narrow assigned slice back to the nearest boundary (surahStart or surahEnd). Since a single days assignment usually sits entirely inside one surah, picking any other surah just bounced back on the next render, looking unresponsive. Reversed-direction plans made this most visible because the default completion point (dayFinishPoint) starts at the low end (surahStart) instead of the high end, so more of the pickers range felt broken.
bugs.fix: Added an optional bounds={lo,hi} prop to both files own CompactSurahAyah copies (duplicated per existing per-file convention). When bounds is passed, the surah <select> only lists surahs that intersect [lo,hi] and the ayah <select> only lists ayat inside that range, so every visible option is guaranteed to stick. Passed bounds={assignment.surahStart/ayahStart .. assignment.surahEnd/ayahEnd} at both actual-completion call sites. The unrelated raw-schedule-row-edit CompactSurahAyah usage in TeacherTrackDetail.tsx (dayRangeStart/dayRangeEnd) and the one in IndividualPlanPanel.tsx were left unbounded on purpose — they edit a plans free-form range, not a bounded days completion point.

bugs.error_message: Teacher reported (Arabic): when the actual completed werd is less than the assigned werd for that day, the plan needs to adjust — today's own "assigned" slice should shrink to match what was actually done, and the leftover should be redistributed across the remaining days.
bugs.root_cause: reflowStudentPlan()'s 'partial' branch correctly redistributed the shortfall across FUTURE pending occurrences (the pool), but never touched the TRIGGERED (today's) occurrence's own surahStart/ayahStart/surahEnd/ayahEnd — those kept showing the full original assignment forever, even after the day was marked partial and its shortfall pushed forward. The schema already had base*/current field pairs (baseSurahEnd vs surahEnd etc.) and IndividualPlanPanel.tsx already renders an 'الأصلي' (struck-through, from base*) vs 'الحالي' (live, from current fields) comparison plus a جزئي/partial badge — clearly designed for exactly this shrink-on-partial behavior — but the current fields were never actually written for the triggered day, so 'الحالي' == 'الأصلي' always for a partial day, silently defeating that UI.
bugs.fix: In the shortfallAyahs > 0 branch (after the existing shortfallAyahs <= 0 early-return), shrink triggered's own boundary to the completedThrough point on the undone side (surahEnd/ayahEnd for a forward day, surahStart/ayahStart for reversed), and recompute pageStart/pageEnd/juz from the new boundary via the already-imported pageOfFlatIndex/juzOfFlatIndex. base* fields are left untouched so the original assignment is still visible for history/audit. Verified via a throwaway script: a 3-day forward plan (2:1-10 / 2:11-20 / 2:21-30), partial-completing day 1 at 2:5 shrinks day 1 to 2:1-2:5 (status partial) and correctly redistributes the 5-ayah shortfall across days 2-3 (2:6-17, 2:18-30).

bugs.error_message: npx expo run:ios fails at pod install: 'The React-Core-prebuilt pod failed to validate due to 1 error: ERROR | attributes: Missing required attribute source'
bugs.root_cause: This Expo SDK 56 / RN 0.85.3 combo's default iOS build mode links a precompiled React-Core.xcframework ('prebuilt RN core') rather than compiling React Native from source, and the shipped prebuilt podspec for this exact version is malformed (missing the podspec 'source' attribute) - a genuine upstream packaging bug, not a project misconfiguration. Deleting node_modules/ios and retrying pod install reproduced the identical failure, ruling out a stale-cache cause.
bugs.fix: Set "ios.buildReactNativeFromSource": "true" in ios/Podfile.properties.json, which flips the Podfile's `ENV['RCT_USE_PREBUILT_RNCORE']` to '0' - forces CocoaPods to compile React Native (and Expo modules) from source instead of linking the broken prebuilt binary. Confirmed via `pod install` log: '[ReactNativeCore] Building from source: true'. Trade-off: first build takes much longer (compiles all of RN/Expo native source) since there's no precompiled artifact to link.

bugs.error_message: npx jest fails with 'TypeError: this._moduleMocker.clearMocksOnScope is not a function' immediately on any test file, before any test runs
bugs.root_cause: npm auto-resolved jest@30.4.2 and jest-expo@57.0.3 (jest-expo's latest published version) when installed without explicit version pins, but this project's Expo SDK is 56 and its RN version is 0.85.3 - jest-expo's major version tracks the Expo SDK major version, so 57.x is for SDK 57, not 56. The resulting dependency tree ended up with a genuine split: top-level jest-mock@30.4.1 (which jest-runtime@30 expects, including the newer clearMocksOnScope API) vs several nested jest-mock@29.7.0 copies pulled in by @react-native/jest-preset and jest-environment-jsdom (both resolved for RN/jest-preset versions expecting jest@29), which lack that method.
bugs.fix: Pinned the whole jest toolchain to the SDK-56-era 29.x line instead of mixing majors: jest@29.7.0, @types/jest@29, jest-expo@56.0.5, @react-native/jest-preset@0.85.3 (exact match to react-native@0.85.3). Also needed a full `rm -rf node_modules && npm install --legacy-peer-deps` afterward since incremental installs left node_modules in an inconsistent partial state (a separate follow-on issue, see bug-332). General lesson: when installing jest-expo/@react-native/jest-preset for an Expo/RN project, always pin explicit versions matching the project's Expo SDK / RN version - never let npm auto-resolve 'latest' for these two packages specifically.

bugs.error_message: After fixing the jest version pins, tests failed with 'Cannot find module expo-modules-core from node_modules/jest-expo/src/preset/setup.js' - even after a full clean node_modules reinstall
bugs.root_cause: npm's hoisting algorithm nested expo-modules-core under node_modules/expo/node_modules/expo-modules-core instead of hoisting it to the top-level node_modules/ (likely due to a version-range difference somewhere else in the dependency graph triggering non-hoisted resolution). jest-expo's setup.js does a plain `require('expo-modules-core')` from its own location in node_modules/jest-expo/, and Node's module resolution walking up the directory tree never finds it nested under a sibling package.
bugs.fix: Ran `npx expo install expo-modules-core` to add it as an explicit top-level dependency, forcing npm to hoist it. General lesson: if jest-expo (or any tool requiring a peer package by bare import rather than relative path) reports a 'Cannot find module' for a package that IS actually installed somewhere in node_modules, check for nested-vs-hoisted placement with `find node_modules -iname <pkg> -type d` before assuming it's genuinely missing.

bugs.error_message: quranRange.test.ts: expected ['2026-01-01', ...] received ['2025-12-31', ...] — schedule entry dates off by one day

bugs.error_message: تكرار «إعادة حساب التوزيع» يُثقل الأيام الأولى تدريجياً (انحراف في التوزيع)

bugs.error_message: EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:5001/api while running `expo run:ios --device` on a physical iPhone — every API call targets the phone itself, not the Mac
bugs.root_cause: 'localhost' inside a physical-device build resolves on the device. The API server runs on the Mac (verified listening on *:5001). Works on the simulator (shares the host loopback), silently broken on hardware — which is why it survived unnoticed.
bugs.fix: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://192.168.100.35:5001/api (Mac LAN IP via `ipconfig getifaddr en0`); verified 401 from the device-reachable URL = server responding. ATS already permits it: ios Info.plist has NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=false BUT NSAllowsLocalNetworking=true, which allows cleartext HTTP to LAN IPs. EXPO_PUBLIC_* is inlined by Metro at bundle time, so a Metro restart applies it — no native rebuild. Old value kept at .env.local.bak; .env.local is gitignored.

bugs.error_message: User: "when it is opened i cant see anything just white page" / "i must see login page or something" — app launches to a permanently blank white screen on a physical iPhone dev build
root_cause: FINAL ROOT CAUSE (verified): ios/build/generated/ios/ReactCodegen/RCTThirdPartyComponentsProvider.mm was generated EMPTY — `thirdPartyComponents = @{ };` with zero entries. React Native's Fabric codegen ran during a previous `pod install` but discovered no libraries, so NO third-party native component was registered in the build. Consequences, all from this one fault: (a) RNCSafeAreaProvider unregistered -> expo-router wraps the whole app in <SafeAreaProvider> with initialMetrics=undefined on native, which renders null until native reports insets; insets never arrived, so the entire React tree below it never mounted -> endless splash with NO error and NO log, because rendering null is not an error; (b) RNSScreenStack / RNSScreenContentWrapper unregistered -> 'Unimplemented component' red overlays once the safe-area gate was bypassed. Strongly suspected trigger: pods were installed while the repo path still contained a space (Downloads/'mina work', see bug-342), the same quoting fault that broke expo-constants — codegen's node_modules scan silently found nothing and emitted an empty registry.
bugs.fix: rm -rf ios/build/generated && cd ios && pod install. Verified the regenerated RCTThirdPartyComponentsProvider.mm now registers 50+ components including RNCSafeAreaProvider, RNCSafeAreaView, RNSScreenStack, RNSScreenContentWrapper, RNGestureHandlerButton, RNDateTimePicker and all RNSVG*. Requires a native rebuild (npx expo run:ios --device) — a JS reload cannot fix it. All diagnostics reverted: app/_layout.tsx, app/index.tsx, app/onboarding.tsx, app/(portal)/_layout.tsx restored via git checkout; node_modules/expo-router/build/ExpoRoot.js restored from .orig. DIAGNOSTIC METHOD THAT WORKED (reuse this): console.log at module scope vs. first line of the component vs. after each hook, to bisect 'module evaluates but component never renders' — that gap is the signature of a null-rendering provider above you, not of an exception.

bugs.error_message: after a reload the mobile app keeps no valid token but still renders portal screens with empty data instead of logging out (NOTE: the 401 work was real hardening but NOT the cause of this report — see the next entry)
bugs.root_cause: apiFetch threw ApiError(401) like any other status — nothing cleared the token or reset authUser, so a rejected/expired token left the user 'signed in' with every query failing (screens render as no-data). A restored deep route inside (portal) could also mount before/without auth.
bugs.fix: api.ts clears the token and calls a registered onUnauthorized handler on any 401 except /auth/login; portalStore registers it and drops the session (authUser/portal/user/navGroups reset) setting sessionExpired; (portal)/_layout.tsx redirects to '/' when hydration is done and there is no authUser; the login screen shows 'انتهت صلاحية جلستك — سجّل الدخول من جديد'.

bugs.error_message: server log: repeated GET /api/students/6a5fd33d2d4a1b4d6b20da40 404 while /api/auth/me returns 200 — mobile showed student screens with no data after a reload
bugs.root_cause: The id is a TEACHER profileId (ibrahim@tahfeez.com) — verified against the DB, where zero User.profileId values are dangling. Resuming a stored session only fills the store (hydrate() never navigates), so the router fell back to the (portal) group's FIRST registered screen — 'student' — for every role. A teacher therefore rendered the student portal, whose hooks call /students/<teacher profileId> and 404 four times a load. Pre-existing: the old Drawer listed 'student' first too.
bugs.fix: (portal)/_layout.tsx now compares usePathname() against authUser.role and redirects to PORTAL_ROUTES[role] whenever they disagree — fixes the resume fallback and blocks deep links into another role's portal.

bugs.error_message: ERROR  Text strings must be rendered within a <Text> component. (thrown from the new teacher attendance screen; stack also blamed admin/parents.tsx)
bugs.root_cause: Alert only wrapped its children in <Text> when `typeof children === 'string'`. Any message with an interpolation (`<Alert>... {name} ...</Alert>`) arrives as an ARRAY of strings, so it fell through to rendering raw strings directly inside a View.
bugs.fix: Alert now uses Children.toArray(children) and wraps in <Text> when every child is a string/number, so interpolated messages work; element children still render as-is.

bugs.error_message: User: "still more in the navbar not working, no bottom sheet is opened in the teacher navbar in mobile" — the "المزيد" tab still does nothing after bug-353
bugs.root_cause: Two defects. (1) @gorhom/bottom-sheet v5's BottomSheetView applies its own style AFTER the caller's: {position:'absolute', top:0, left:0, right:0} with no bottom/height, so it hugs content height. MoreSheet's root child is flex:1, which collapses to 0 inside it — the sheet presented but rendered completely empty. Same defect silently broke FormSelect's BottomSheetFlatList. (2) The bug-353 fix opened the sheet from a Tabs.Screen listeners.tabPress + e.preventDefault(), which depends on react-navigation's tabPress plumbing surviving expo-router's withLayoutContext screen re-creation on every render.
bugs.fix: (1) BottomSheet.tsx now passes a `contentFill` style ({bottom: 0}) to BottomSheetView whenever snapPoints are given — `bottom` is the one edge the library does not overwrite, so the view fills the sheet's already-explicit height. Kept the content-hugging style for the enableDynamicSizing path, where filling would feed back into the height calculation. (2) MoreSheet's tile list got flex:1 so the footer stays pinned and tiles scroll. (3) Replaced listeners.tabPress with a custom tabBarButton (components/layout/MoreTabButton.tsx, memoised per layout) that calls setMoreOpen(true) directly — the press never enters the navigate path. Applied to all four portals. npx tsc --noEmit clean.

bugs.error_message: User (3rd report): "still i keep click in more and not working" — no bottom sheet ever appears, anywhere in the app
bugs.root_cause: The controlled wrapper ran `if (visible) present(); else dismiss();` in a useEffect, so EVERY BottomSheet called dismiss() on its first mount (visible always starts false). In @gorhom/bottom-sheet v5, BottomSheetModal.handleDismiss() on a never-presented modal takes the non-early-exit branch (status is INITIAL, not CLOSED/MINIMIZED): it sets statusRef = MODAL_STATUS.DISMISSING and calls bottomSheetRef.current?.forceClose() — but bottomSheetRef is null because nothing is mounted yet, so no animation callback ever runs to clear the status. The modal is then stuck in DISMISSING, and handlePortalRender short-circuits with `if ([MODAL_STATUS.DISMISSING].includes(statusRef.current)) return;`, so a later present() mounts state but renders nothing into the portal. Silent: no error, no warning. Affected MoreSheet, FormSelect, FormDatePicker and all four admin/parents sheets — no sheet in the app had ever opened.
bugs.fix: BottomSheet.tsx tracks `wasPresented` in a ref and only calls dismiss() for a true->false transition, never on first mount. onDismiss also clears the flag before calling onClose, because the library resets the modal to INITIAL during unmount — without that, the visible->false render after a swipe-to-dismiss would re-poison the modal and break every subsequent open. npx tsc --noEmit clean.

bugs.error_message: handleSend() in recordlesson.tsx awaited createRecording.mutateAsync() with no catch — a failed save rejected the async press handler (unhandled promise rejection) instead of being handled
bugs.root_cause: mutateAsync rejects on error; the handler had no try/catch, so the rejection escaped the onPress handler and setSent(true)/onSent() were skipped only as a side effect of the throw
bugs.fix: Wrapped the mutateAsync call in try/catch: the catch fires the error haptic and returns early (failure is already surfaced via createRecording.isError), success haptic + setSent/onSent run only on the resolved path

bugs.error_message: MoreSheet rows render as a bare vertical stack — no card background, border or padding; icon chip, label and chevron each on their own line; Arabic group labels left-aligned
bugs.root_cause: Two independent defects. (1) The rows used the callback form `style={({ pressed }) => [...]}`; the whole style was dropped, leaving a default column View. The header's close button, the ONLY control in the sheet using a plain object style, rendered correctly through the same <Pressable> wrapper — so the callback form, not the wrapper, is what fails here. Measured evidence: chip/title/desc/chevron sat at 4 stacked y-offsets totalling exactly the sum of their intrinsic heights (113pt) with no padding or gap. (2) `textAlign: 'auto'` resolves to LEFT in this build, so Arabic Text in a full-width container aligns left; text only looked correct where it was a content-sized flex child in a row (the header title).
bugs.fix: Rows now take a plain object/array style (`style={styles.row}`), pressed-tint dropped in favour of the haptic press-in feedback. Added explicit `textAlign: 'right'` to groupLabel/rowLabel/rowDesc/title/userName/userRole.

bugs.error_message: User: on the create-plan surah picker sheet — 'when scroll down it scroll but when stop scrolling in the center and continue scrolling it go from the start agin'
bugs.root_cause: FormSelect opened its sheet with snapPoints={['50%','80%']}. @gorhom/bottom-sheet marks the scrollable LOCKED whenever the sheet sits below its HIGHEST snap point (useScrollEventsHandlersDefault: SCROLLABLE_STATUS.LOCKED -> scrollTo(0, lockPosition) on every onScroll / onEndDrag / onMomentumEnd). At the 50% snap the 114-item surah list was therefore force-scrolled back to the offset the drag started from, which reads as 'jumps back to the start'.
bugs.fix: Single snap point (['85%']) so the sheet is always EXTENDED and the list is UNLOCKED. Also added a header, Arabic-normalised search for lists >= 12 options, fixed 52pt rows + getItemLayout + initialScrollIndex (opens on the current value), and a selection-tick haptic per row scrolled past via onViewableItemsChanged.

bugs.error_message: User (Arabic/English, with screenshot of teacher/plan-form): 'alot of text around the app is on the left not right? like the header title of inputs and header of bottom sheets this is wrong'
bugs.root_cause: The app forces RTL (I18nManager.forceRTL in app/_layout.tsx) and React Native then SWAPS left/right text alignment — effectiveParagraphStyle in RCTTextAttributes.mm maps NSTextAlignmentRight to NSTextAlignmentLeft when the view's layout direction is RTL. So FormGroup/CardHeader/DataTable/MoreSheet's `textAlign: 'right'` rendered visually LEFT, and Text with no textAlign resolved left as well. A previous session had recorded the opposite rule in cerebrum ('needs an explicit textAlign: right'), which spread the wrong fix. <TextInput> is unaffected by the swap, which is why inputs looked correct while their labels did not.
bugs.fix: Added lib/theme.ts textStart/textEnd tokens ('left' = visually right) with the RN source reference, plus components/ui/Text.tsx wrapping RN <Text> with textAlign: textStart as a base style (call-site styles still override). Swept all 69 files importing Text from 'react-native' onto the wrapper and deleted the 15 harmful `textAlign: 'right'` entries from <Text> styles, keeping them on the 4 <TextInput> styles. Corrected the wrong cerebrum guidance.

bugs.error_message: User: "the more sheet has problem with scroll and the bottom part witch have name and avatar and dark mood not showing" + "need some space buttom"
bugs.root_cause: Footer: the avatar/name/theme-toggle bar was a plain flex sibling laid out at the bottom of the wrapper's BottomSheetView, so once the content overflowed it was laid out past the sheet's bottom edge and never rendered. Scroll: MoreSheet nested a BottomSheetScrollView inside BottomSheetView, whose focus effect sets animatedScrollableState.type = SCROLLABLE_TYPE.VIEW; React fires child effects before parent ones, so the parent always overwrote the scrollable's own registration. CORRECTION to the first write-up of this entry: that mis-registration does NOT stop the list from scrolling — useGestureEventsHandlersDefault only reads the type for over-drag resistance (a VIEW over-drags the whole sheet instead of letting the list rubber-band) and for the keyboard-dismiss branch. So the nesting made drags inside the list move the sheet, which is the 'problem with scroll' the user felt, but it is not a hard scroll break.
bugs.fix: BottomSheet.tsx gained a `rawContent` prop that renders children straight into BottomSheetModal with no BottomSheetView wrapper (documented on the prop), plus a `footerComponent` passthrough. MoreSheet now sets rawContent, moved the user footer into a <BottomSheetFooter bottomInset={insets.bottom}> rendered via footerComponent (absolute + zIndex 9999, so it cannot be pushed off), gave the footer its own opaque theme.card background + paddingBottom since it now overlays the list, set enableFooterMarginAdjustment on the scroll view so content clears it, raised the snap point to 85% and bumped listContent paddingBottom to space.xl. npx tsc --noEmit clean.

bugs.error_message: User: "والتاريخ محتاج يظهر بالميلادي مش الهجري في كل الاماكن" — dates rendered as Hijri (e.g. ٢٥ رمضان ١٤٤٧) everywhere, in both the mobile app and the web app
bugs.file: quran-hifz-mobile/lib/date.ts (new) + 18 call sites, quran-hifz/src/lib/format.ts + 19 call sites, quran-hifz-mobile/components/forms/FormDatePicker.tsx
bugs.root_cause: Every date went through toLocaleDateString('ar-SA'). Per CLDR the DEFAULT CALENDAR for the ar-SA locale is islamic-umalqura, so ICU renders a Hijri date from a Gregorian Date object with no error and no warning. The iOS inline DateTimePicker had the same problem from locale="ar", which resolves its NSCalendar from the device region.
bugs.fix: Added a single AR_LOCALE = 'ar-EG' constant per app (mobile lib/date.ts, which also exports fmtDate/fmtDateLong/fmtDateShort helpers that pin bare YYYY-MM-DD strings to LOCAL midnight; web src/lib/format.ts alongside toAr/pct) and swept every 'ar-SA' literal in both apps onto it, including the DateTimePicker's locale prop. ar-EG is Arabic with the Gregorian calendar and Arabic-Indic digits, which is what the UI already assumed. Mobile tsc clean; web tsc shows only the two pre-existing errors (Badge style prop in ParentHomeworkView, sitemap route).

bugs.error_message: User: "the sheet of the pick سوره and number look very bad (the one you use picker into need to be choosen need to be bold and all the text in middel)" and "the sheet of the date must scroll buttom to see the button"
bugs.root_cause: FormSelect's option rows still used the `style={({ pressed }) => [...]}` callback form that bug-360 had already identified as dropping the style on this project's ui Pressable, and the label was a flex:1 start-aligned Text sharing a space-between row with the check icon, so nothing lined up. FormDatePicker laid the إلغاء/تم row out after the calendar, so any month whose inline picker overshot the sheet's measured height pushed the confirm button below the fold.
bugs.fix: FormSelect: plain array style, label centred between two equal 22pt slots (the check fills one, so the label stays on the row's centre line without absolute positioning, whose left/right Yoga swaps under forceRTL), selected row bold + green + a stronger tint, header title centred with a spacer mirroring the close button, and rawContent + an insets-aware list paddingBottom. FormDatePicker: إلغاء/تم moved into a pinned BottomSheetFooter via footerComponent, with enableFooterMarginAdjustment on BottomSheetView so dynamic sizing still measures tall enough for it.

bugs.error_message: User (screenshot of teacher/track-detail): the توزيع الأيام والصفحات row renders as a vertical stack — calendar chip, title, "3 يوم" and chevron each on their own line. "those need to be beside each other not under each other"
bugs.root_cause: `style={({ pressed }) => [...]}` again. CONFIRMS AND CORRECTS bug-360, which blamed components/ui/Pressable: the real cause is NativeWind. The app sets jsxImportSource: 'nativewind', and its JSX interop drops function-valued `style` on native, so the component renders with NO style — SheetTriggerRow lost its flexDirection:'row' and collapsed to the default column. components/ui/Button.tsx already documented this exact cause (its coloured box is a plain View for the same reason) but the note never made it into cerebrum, so the form kept getting written.
bugs.fix: Swept every remaining function-style Pressable in the app onto plain array styles (SheetTriggerRow, MasjidAccordion, app/index.tsx child cards, student/messages rows) and deleted the now-unreachable rowPressed/triggerPressed/cardPressed/msgPressed styles — the press-in haptic is the feedback. Recorded the NativeWind root cause in cerebrum Do-Not-Repeat. tsc clean.

bugs.error_message: User: "remove the bg from تفاصيل المسار and all those who had bg in the top like that" — the hand-rolled screen headers rendered as a white bar sitting on the page surface
bugs.root_cause: Design change, not a defect: the four stack screens that draw their own back-arrow header all shared an identical header style with backgroundColor: theme.card + a 1px bottom border, which read as a separate bar over theme.bg.
bugs.fix: Dropped backgroundColor and borderBottom from all four; the header now sits directly on the page surface. These are the only hand-rolled headers in the app — every navigator has headerShown: false. NOTE (not fixed, out of scope): all four import the STATIC `theme` rather than useAppTheme(), so they do not respond to the dark-mode toggle.

bugs.error_message: admin students list not mobile friendly: long gold track badge runs off the screen edge, guardian name+email collides with the attendance figure
bugs.root_cause: Badge had no flexShrink/maxWidth and its text was unbounded, so a long special-track title overflowed its flex row; the students row packed name+badge and attendance+guardian into two space-between rows with no line budget at phone widths.
bugs.fix: Badge defaults to numberOfLines=1 with flexShrink:1 + maxWidth:'100%' and accepts numberOfLines/style. Students row restructured: name + attendance tone pill, full-width track chip on its own line, wrapping halqa/masjid/level chips, guardian name and contact on separate ellipsized lines, progress label/percent above the bar.

bugs.error_message: alot of things and cards and buttom sheets are white when dark mode
bugs.root_cause: lib/theme.ts exported `const theme = buildTheme('light')` - a LIGHT theme frozen at import time. 45 files imported it and read colours inside a module-scope StyleSheet.create({...}), which runs ONCE on first import, so the light surfaces were baked into the compiled style IDs and no mode toggle could repaint them. Only the 34 files already on useAppTheme() reacted. Compounding it, the pastel tints (greenPale/goldPale/cream) and the Badge/Alert/DataTable palettes lived in the mode-INDEPENDENT `base` object or as inline hex, so even a reactive component still painted light pastels in dark mode.
bugs.fix: Deleted the static `theme` export entirely so tsc flags every offender (45 errors), moved every mode-dependent colour out of `base` into light/darkSurfaces, added mode-aware tokens (cardAlt, inputBg, overlay, greenAccent, and a shared `tone` bg/border/text map for green/gold/red/blue/gray), then converted all 45 files to `const theme = useAppTheme()` + `useMemo(() => createStyles(theme), [theme])`. Also swept hardcoded '#fff'/'#F0FDF4' surfaces, the four tab bars (backgroundColor theme.white -> theme.card), and every `backgroundColor: theme.green` fill -> theme.greenAccent (the brand green is near-black and vanishes on a dark surface).

bugs.error_message: admin special tracks on mobile deleted a track immediately on tapping حذف, with no confirmation
bugs.root_cause: The list row wired the delete Pressable straight to deleteTrack.mutate(t._id); the web page's confirm dialog was never ported.
bugs.fix: Added a deleteId state + transparent RN Modal confirm dialog ('حذف المسار — سيُحذف المسار نهائياً ولا يمكن التراجع') matching the web page; the row press only opens it.

bugs.error_message: parent recordings on mobile never shows the teacher's note, lesson type, or points
bugs.root_cause: mobile ChildRecording declares `notes?` and the screen renders `r.notes`, but the server (LessonRecording.model.ts, parent.controller.getChildRecordings) returns `teacherNote`, plus `type` and `points` which the mobile type omits entirely. The wrong field name is type-clean because the type itself is wrong.

bugs.error_message: admin 'تسجيل طالب جديد' on mobile saved nothing — the form was a mock
bugs.root_cause: handleSubmit only flipped a local `submitted` flag and showed a success banner; no mutation was called. Fields were invented (national id, birth date, relation) and the halqa picker read a hardcoded lib/data/halqat.ts mock instead of the API.
bugs.fix: Rewired to useCreateStudent with the web's field set + validation (name/age/guardianPhone/reading level/level/masjid/halqa/optional credentials), path derived via the ported pickMasar, and the returned credentials shown in the shared CredentialsDialog. Deleted the unused lib/data/halqat.ts mock.

bugs.error_message: reports scope tabs unreadable — every label truncated to 3 letters ("كل الـ… أبو بك… حفص…")
bugs.root_cause: The component was a segmented control with `tab: { flex: 1 }`, so N options split ONE screen width. With 9 scopes (all + 6 halqat + 2 tracks) each tab got ~35pt and numberOfLines={1} ellipsized every name after 3 characters.
bugs.fix: Segmented layout is now kept only for <=3 options; beyond that the component renders a horizontally scrolling chip row with content-sized pills (maxWidth 200), a per-kind icon (all/halqa/track) and a filled green active chip.

bugs.error_message: Mobile track detail showed every student in a track to any teacher, and fetched the entire student list to do it
bugs.root_cause: Roster was built from a bare useStudents() (all students) filtered client-side by halqa.specialTrack, instead of the web's teacher-scoped useHalqat({teacher}) -> useStudents({halqa: ids}) chain
bugs.fix: Scope halqat by teacher for role='teacher' (all halqat for admin), narrow to the ones on this track, and fetch only those halqat's students via useStudents({halqa: ids.join(',')}, {enabled})

bugs.error_message: Mobile track detail could latch onto the wrong Quran plan for a track
bugs.root_cause: Took linkedPlans[0] blindly. A plan can keep a stale `specialTrack` ref after its targetType is switched to 'students', so the filtered list can contain several plans for one track
bugs.fix: Prefer the plan actually targeting the track: linkedPlans.find(p => p.targetType === 'specialTrack') ?? linkedPlans[0] — same rule the web page uses

bugs.error_message: Admin opening a track detail downloaded every Quran plan in the system
bugs.root_cause: useQuranPlans({teacher: profileId}) ran for both roles. Admin users are seeded with no profileId, so the `teacher` param was dropped and GET /quran-plans returned everything — for a link panel that is teacher-only and never rendered for admin
bugs.fix: Added an `opts.enabled` escape hatch to useQuranPlans (matching useStudents' convention) and gated the call behind canManagePlan

bugs.error_message: Admin track card's 'مقرَّر اليوم' could disagree with the same track's detail screen
bugs.root_cause: Card took linkedPlans[0]; a plan retains its specialTrack ref after targetType switches to 'students', so the filter can return several plans. Same root cause as bug-375, different screen. The web copy (quran-hifz/src/quran/pages/admin/AdminSpecialTracks.tsx:707) still has it

bugs.error_message: a FormSelect opened from inside an add/edit form appeared BEHIND the form — the picker was unreachable
bugs.root_cause: FormModal was built on React Native's <Modal>, which is a separate NATIVE WINDOW stacked above the React root. FormSelect's picker is a @gorhom/bottom-sheet BottomSheetModal that renders into the single BottomSheetModalProvider mounted in app/_layout.tsx — i.e. inside the root, therefore underneath the RN Modal window.
bugs.fix: Deleted FormModal and moved every admin add/edit form to its own route (masjid-form, halqa-form, teacher-form, student-form) built on a new shared components/ui/FormPage.tsx (back header + scrolling body + sticky save/cancel footer). A route has no native window of its own, so the picker sheet lands on top; long forms also get the full screen and normal keyboard avoidance. ConfirmDialog/CredentialsDialog stay RN Modals — they contain no pickers.

bugs.error_message: masjid accordion header overlapped: the location text ran underneath the '3 حلقات' badge and the edit/delete buttons
bugs.root_cause: Header was one row: [icon + name + location] (flex:1) beside [badge + actions + chevron]. The name and location were plain <Text> with no numberOfLines and no flexShrink, so a long masjid name ('جامع الأمير متعب بن عبد العزيز') overflowed its container and painted over the right-hand group.
bugs.fix: Split into two rows: a tappable row with the icon, a stacked name (2 lines) + location (1 line) column that flexes and shrinks, and the chevron; then a meta row carrying the halqa count badge and the admin actions.

bugs.error_message: in the المزيد sheet the last rows (تسجيل الخروج) were hidden under the pinned user/theme footer card
bugs.root_cause: The footer was lifted off the bottom edge with <BottomSheetFooter bottomInset={insets.bottom}>. gorhom applies bottomInset as a translateY and records ONLY the footer container's measured height as footerHeight; `enableFooterMarginAdjustment` pads the scroll content by that height alone, so the footer visually occupied footerHeight + insets.bottom and the content was under-padded by exactly the safe-area inset.
bugs.fix: Dropped bottomInset and moved the safe-area gap inside the footer as paddingBottom (theme.space.md + insets.bottom), so the measured height includes it and the content padding matches what the footer actually covers. Same change applied to FormDatePicker's footer.

bugs.error_message: Teacher students page showed only the first halqa's students
bugs.root_cause: useStudents({ halqa: halqat[0]?._id }) — a teacher running more than one halqa lost every student outside halqa #1. The web page joins all halqa ids
bugs.fix: Fetch with { halqa: halqaIds.join(',') } gated on halqaIds.length, and add the web's كل الطلاب / per-halqa / per-track filter

bugs.error_message: parent 'مسيرة الحفظ' timeline showed six hardcoded fake milestones instead of the child's real surah records
bugs.root_cause: The screen shipped with a module-scope TL array of mock events (محرم ١٤٤٦ … ذو الحجة ١٤٤٦) and never called useChildHifz — every parent saw identical invented data.
bugs.fix: Rebuilt on useChildHifz: one node per surah with its real status (مكتمل/جارٍ/لم يبدأ), notes and completion date, drawn as a rail-and-dot timeline.

bugs.error_message: a parent with more than one child could not switch child after login on mobile
bugs.root_cause: components/domain/ChildSelector.tsx exists and its own doc says it belongs at the top of the parent dashboard, but it was never mounted there — the child was only chosen once in the post-login modal in app/index.tsx, so switching meant logging out.

bugs.error_message: Maximum update depth exceeded (RootLayout app/_layout.tsx:84 <Stack.Protected>) when an admin taps تعديل الخطة in the track detail plan tab
bugs.root_cause: TrackDetail is shared by both portals but hard-coded its pushes to '/(portal)/teacher/plan-form'. The admin Tabs navigator (app/(portal)/admin/_layout.tsx) does not own that route, so expo-router could not resolve it and the root <Stack.Protected> guard re-rendered without converging instead of failing cleanly. Surfaced only after canManagePlan was opened to admin, which made the button reachable

bugs.error_message: Admin creating a Quran plan would fail server validation (teacher: z.string().min(1) required)
bugs.root_cause: On create the form sent `body.teacher = profileId`, which is undefined for admin users (they are seeded without a profileId)
bugs.fix: Fall back to the selected halqa's own teacher id, with an inline Arabic error when neither is available
